schema.text: When you travel by car, have you experienced or do you fear harassment because of who you are or how you look (e.g. gender, appearance, origin, age)?

ar.#When you travel by car, have you experi: عند التنقل بالسيارة، هل سبق أن تعرضت للتحرش بسبب هويتك أو مظهرك (مثل النوع الاجتماعي أو المظهر أو الأصل أو السن)، أو هل يقلقك ذلك؟

de.#When you travel by car, have you experi: Haben Sie bei Autofahrten Belästigung wegen Ihrer Person oder Ihres Aussehens (z. B. Geschlecht, Aussehen, Herkunft, Alter) erlebt oder befürchten Sie sie?

en.#When you travel by car, have you experi: When you travel by car, have you experienced or do you fear harassment because of who you are or how you look (e.g. gender, appearance, origin, age)?

fa.#When you travel by car, have you experi: هنگام سفر با خودرو، آیا به دلیل ویژگی‌های شخصی یا ظاهرتان (مثلاً جنسیت، ظاهر، اصالت، سن) آزار دیده‌اید یا از آن می‌ترسید؟

fr.#When you travel by car, have you experi: Lorsque vous vous déplacez en voiture, avez-vous subi ou redoutez-vous du harcèlement en raison de qui vous êtes ou de votre aspect (par ex. genre, apparence, origine, âge) ?

hu.#When you travel by car, have you experi: Autós utazás közben élt át vagy tart zaklatástól amiatt, hogy ki Ön vagy hogyan néz ki (pl. nem, külső, származás, életkor)?

it.#When you travel by car, have you experi: Quando viaggi in auto, hai subito o temi molestie per chi sei o per come appari (es. genere, aspetto, origine, età)?

tr.#When you travel by car, have you experi: Arabayla yolculuk ederken kim olduğunuz ya da nasıl göründüğünüz nedeniyle (örn. cinsiyet, görünüş, köken, yaş) taciz yaşadınız mı ya da bundan korkuyor musunuz?
